corpus.note: Domain-knowledge regression labels pinned to this corpus snapshot (todo:b22586bc, design §9.3). Two assertion kinds, neither circular: (1) tradition-anchored queries use a distinctive term whose tradition a comparative-religion reader would assert regardless of the system — recall is 'did the expected tradition survive into top-K'; (2) hierarchy queries assert the query plane engages (minConcepts) + breadth (minTraditions). These are NOT chunk-level relevance judgments — those need human ratification (follow-up). Re-baseline deliberately when corpus_version changes; do not let it silently rot.
